Name: Tortilla Flooring and Wallpaper
Author: Flor3nce2456
Description:
Adds a set of 4 Floorings and Wallpapers each with a Tortilla Theme. For Alternative Textures.

Comes in:
Vanilla Tortilla Wallpaper and Floor
Slightly Toasted Tortilla Wallpaper and Floor (For those who want a Slightly Darker look)
Tortillas Nailed to the Wall and Floor
Tortillas Nailed to Slightly Toasted Tortilla Wallpaper and Floor (For those who want Tortilla Maxxing)

8 total new items.

Depending on the mods you have installed, you might even see them for sale at Pierre's and Joja, and find them in the Catalog.
Otherwise, you will need to [b]buy the Paint Bucket from Robin to get these.

[/b]Also featuring the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28001]Cozy Nooks Farmhouse[/url] in the Photos.
